scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @formly/backend build:types && pnpm --filter @formly/core build && pnpm --parallel --filter @formly/backend --filter @formly/core --filter @formly/frontend run dev:workspace
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @formly/backend build:types && pnpm --filter @formly/core build && ng build
scripts.watch: pnpm --filter @formly/backend build:types && pnpm --filter @formly/core build && pnpm --parallel --filter @formly/backend --filter @formly/core --filter @formly/frontend run watch:workspace
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @formly/backend build:types && pnpm --filter @formly/core build && NG_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:3000/ ng test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @formly/backend build:types && pnpm --filter @formly/core build && NG_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:3000/ ng test --no-watch --configuration coverage
